description: Top10Vector – Réseau haute tension is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by NGI. ‘Top10Vector – High-voltage network’ is the vector dataset for the Belgian high-tension grid. The dataset consists of 2 feature types: high-voltage line segments [HThightensionlinesegment] and high-voltage pylons [HTpowerpylon]. The dataset can be downloaded via the links in 'Access' at the bottom of this page. Coverage: NGI. The portal shows the English title as "Top10Vector – High-voltage network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is NGI. The listing shows 5 download or service links in GPKG, SHP, WMS. The listing shows 2026-01-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
